name: Calming tablets
镇静药
description: Settles your thoughts and eases stress. Makes you drowsy.
安定心神，缓解压力，但容易犯困。

name: Sleeping tablets
助眠药
description: Helps you sleep, though you may still have nightmares.
有助于睡眠，但仍可能做噩梦。

name: Wakefulness tablets
提神药
description: Keeps tiredness at bay for a while. It returns when the effect wears off.
暂时压下困意，药效过后疲劳会回来。

name: Concentration tablets
专注药
description: Helps you learn faster, but makes you tense.
让你学得更快，但会更紧张。

name: Soothing tablets
安神药
description: Eases trauma for a while. Symptoms may return when the effect wears off.
暂时减轻创伤，药效过后可能反弹。
